notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 whole-ferris-wheel mask was a filled disc (~39% sky between spokes) -> recolour of the round 'B' hub emblem (SAM3 v2). U2 game-booth mask was a ragged, heavily occluded fragment and the payload a recolour -> retargeted to the pink plush rabbit, replaced by a teddy bear (v2). U3 was a tiny pennant among many identical ones (ref said left, it is at the right edge) -> retargeted to removing the large plush eagle at the top left (v2). U4 tag is under the toy machine gun, not 'the sign at the left'; payload made specific.
